For codes that are rejected, both guides say the usual cause is the phone's clock. Ask the user to turn on automatic date and time on the phone, and the codes will be accepted again with no change on our side [KB-0008, KB-0030]. Both also say to verify the caller first, the same way as for a password reset, before changing any sign-in method [KB-0008, KB-0030].

If the phone was replaced or the app was deleted, the two articles conflict on how re-registration is handled:

- **KB-0008:** Delete the old authenticator registration, require the user to register again, and stay on the phone while they sign in. The user completes registration on their own device, and the service desk does not need to handle the phone [KB-0008].
- **KB-0030:** Remove the old registration, then arrange a short call or visit and register the new phone together with the user. Do not leave the user to re-register on their own [KB-0030].

The knowledge base has a conflict warning on these two articles. The service desk lead, who keeps the knowledge base up to date, should resolve it.
